description:
Spacious Two Bedroom Fifth floor City Centre Apartment

Echo Buildings proudly stands within Sunderland City Centre, benefitting from fabulous views over the river and cityscape. A range of amenities are short stroll away, including Sunderland Empire Theatre, popular independent cafés and eateries, bespoke shops and larger supermarkets, cinema and museum, as well as being within easy reach of Sunderland Royal Hospital and the University of Sunderland. A stone's throw from Sunderland Metro Station, frequent bus services, and major road links, the location is ideal for those who regularly commute throughout the area and wider region. 

With lift and stair access to the apartment, the accommodation itself briefly comprises:- An entrance hallway, a spacious open-plan lounge/kitchen with French doors flowing out onto the balcony, offering stunning views over the river and integrated appliances to the kitchen, a generous double bedroom with its own en-suite shower room, and a principal bathroom. 

An ideal purchase for students, first-time-buyers and investors - Early viewings are advised. 

ENTRANCE HALLWAY 
Hardwood entrance door into the hallway with storage cupboard and electric wall heater. 
OPEN-PLAN LOUNGE/KITCHEN 7.87m (25'10)  x 4.27m (14'0) 
Double glazed French doors onto balcony, base and wall units, stainless steel sink with mixer tap, electric oven and hob, integrated fridge/freezer. 
BEDROOM 2.81m (9'3)  x 3.36m (11'0) 
Double glazed window with river views, electric wall heater. 
MASTER BEDROOM 6.2m (20'4)  x 3.89m (12'9) 
Double glazed window with river views, electric wall heater. 
EN-SUITE SHOWER ROOM 
Shower cubicle, low level w/c, wash basin, chrome radiator. 
BATHROOM 
Tiled walls, white suite comprising panelled bath, low level w/c, wash basin.
Tenure 
We are advised that the property is Leasehold with a term of 125 years from 01/12/2004.

We will provide as much information about tenure as we are able to and in the case of leasehold properties, we can in most cases provide a copy of the lease. They can be complex and buyers are advised to take legal advice upon the full terms of a lease. Where a lease is not readily available we will apply for a copy and this can take time.
Broadband & Mobile Coverage 
The Ofcom website states the average broadband download speed of 18 Mbps and a maximum download speed of 1000 Mbps at this postcode: SR1 1XD and mobile coverage is provided by EE, Three, O2 and Vodafone. *The checker results are predictions and should not be regarded as guaranteed. 
Council Tax 
The GOV.UK website states the property is Council Tax Band: D

Money Laundering Regulations 
Please note that any offers will require you to be financially verified, meaning you'll need to provide us sight of a mortgage in principle, proof of deposit funds, and proof of cash. You'll also need to provide us with full chain details including agents and solicitors down the chain. To comply with Money Laundering Regulations all buyers will be required to provide us with proof of identification before we can issue acceptance letters and solicitors are instructed.
Material Information 
The information provided about this property does not constitute or form part of an offer or contract, nor may it be regarded as representations. All interested parties must verify accuracy and your solicitor must verify tenure and lease information, fixtures and fittings and, where the property has been recently constructed, extended or converted, that planning/building regulation consents are in place. All dimensions are approximate and quoted for guidance only, as are floor plans which are not to scale and their accuracy cannot be confirmed. Reference to appliances and/or services does not imply that they are necessarily in working order or fit for purpose. We offer our clients an optional conveyancing service, through panel conveyancing firms, via Move With Us and we receive on average a referral fee of one hundred and ninety four pounds, only on completion of the sale. If you do use this service, the referral fee is included within the amount that you will be quoted by our suppliers. All quotes will also provide details of referral fees payable.
